mapper.select: SELECT p.user_id,p.risk_level,p.investment_goal,p.goal_category,p.horizon_years,p.liquidity_need, p.experience_years,p.account_type,p.evaluated_at,p.valid_until, (SELECT a.id FROM risk_assessment a WHERE a.user_id=p.user_id AND a.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' ORDER BY a.evaluated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_assessment_id FROM risk_profile p WHERE p.user_id=#{id} AND p.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
